reason: E1 shows Hf forms precipitates in single-phase FCC HEAs and suggests trace Hf is worth investigating, but does not demonstrate boundary pinning or room-temperature ductility improvement. E2 shows Hf-rich precipitates pin boundaries and improve ductility, but only at high temperatures (600–900°C) in a different microstructure, not room-temperature lamellar eutectic HEAs. The key premises about room-temperature boundary pinning, reduced microcracking, and precipitation strengthening in lamellar eutectic HEAs are not directly supported by the cited evidence.
